<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 233.9632. Assuming this is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈233.9632 – 1.0073 = 232.956 Da. A formula that matches this mass within typical analytical tolerance is C₁₃H₁₄NO₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H14NO3</final_answer>
